purpose: Matched incremental feasibility comparison; starting adapter already favors range syntax. Not an equal from-scratch architecture comparison.
selection: Typed must improve total exact over both retained baseline and matched range arm, preserve every correct output from either comparator, and improve at least one punctuation/filler/context diagnostic group. Otherwise reject and stop.
conditionalGate: Only if selected: evaluate historical79+fresh16 with paired baseline, preserve all baseline-correct ordinary outputs and review changed/adversarial outputs. Native compiler/runtime parity required before any promotion.
stop: One100-step run per trained arm; no prompt, budget or data revisions after results. No app or ADR changes.
